title: Core: AS2 Number formatting and conversions
description: Verify AS2 Number formatting compiles: n.toString(radix) (binary, hex, octal), n.toFixed(decimals), n.toPrecision(digits), n.toExponential(digits). Also verify Number.MAX_VALUE, Number.MIN_VALUE, Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY, Number.NEGATIVE_INFINITY, Number.NaN constants. Tests in packages/core/src/as2/__tests__/numberformat.test.ts.
